_doc: Known, documented divergences of the reference clients. Fields (all optional; strings are anchored regexes): impl target case cred op kind; oid (prefix); baseType otherType baseError otherError. Every entry needs a reason. Do NOT allowlist 'ours' bugs here unless the behaviour is a deliberate, documented choice.

entries.reason: gosnmp v1.47.0 parseOpaque() returns ErrZeroByteBuffer for a zero-length Opaque (edge-agent 1.3.6.1.4.1.99997.1.19.0), so the whole response PDU fails to decode. Upstream bug; net-snmp and pysnmp return Opaque "".
Consequence of gosnmp-empty-opaque-decode: every varbind in (and after) the undecodable response is missing.

pysnmp 7.1 retransmits with a new message handle and drops the pending state of the first transmission, so a reply to the original request that arrives during the retry window is discarded -> timeout. net-snmp and gosnmp accept it.

Deliberate (docs/internals.md §1): on tooBig during a GETBULK walk, nf-snmp halves max-repetitions and continues from the same OID instead of stopping, so it completes walks of agents with small PDU limits. The references stop with the tooBig error.
